    [2, 1, 1, 4],
    [2, 2, 1, 3],
    [3, 1, 2, 2],
    [2, 1, 3, 2]
]

# Function to play a smooth bass pattern
def playSoftBass(notes, rhythms):
    for i in range(len(notes)):

        # Longer notes create a calm feeling
        if rhythms[i] >= 3:
            playNote(notes[i], beats=rhythms[i])

        # Shorter notes add gentle movement
        else:
            playNote(notes[i], beats=rhythms[i])

# Play the bass patterns in order
for section in range(4):

    currentNotes = bassPatterns[section]
    currentRhythm = bassRhythms[section]

    playSoftBass(currentNotes, currentRhythm)
